critical_path: Week 1: Publish first 5 pieces immediately - velocity creates momentum and learning
Week 2: Define Content DNA through client interviews - this guides all future content
Week 3: Validate 3 segments with real feedback - prevents wasted effort on wrong audiences
Week 4: Launch first lead magnet and nurture sequence - begins conversion machinery
Week 6: Create content frameworks/templates - enables scaling without quality loss
Week 7: Optimize top performers with better CTAs - maximizes existing asset value
Week 9: Build repeatable production system - required for 10 pieces/week without burnout
Week 11: Implement advanced conversion tracking - proves ROI and guides investment
quick_wins: Publish best 5 existing pieces in Week 1 - immediate visibility and traffic
Email existing network with top 3 pieces - fast engagement and early leads
Post daily on LinkedIn with insights (not just links) - builds authority immediately
Set up Google Analytics and track everything - data from day one
Create simple lead magnet from existing content - start capturing emails Week 1
Join 3 relevant communities and introduce yourself helpfully - immediate distribution channel
Reach out to 5 best clients for interviews - builds DNA and potential testimonials

Month 1 lead magnets → Month 3 email list: Early list building creates owned audience of 400+ for direct promotion
Month 1 community presence → Month 3 referrals: Consistent helpful contributions establish expertise, generate word-of-mouth
Month 1 content library → Month 3 internal linking: 88 pieces create powerful topic clusters that boost collective SEO
Month 2 nurture sequences → Month 3 automated sales: Evergreen sequences convert leads 24/7 without active effort
Month 2 case studies → Month 3 sales velocity: Proof content reduces sales cycle by 40%, increases close rates
